overview: Selling Ireland's Dream Homes gives viewers a peek inside some of the country's most quirky, unusual and pricey properties. We showcase the very best in high end homes for sale across Ireland, taking in everything from urban villas, country mansions, swish penthouses to historic palazzo. Whilst seeing inside some of our country's most exclusive homes, we also meet the agents tasked to sell these masterpieces and meet their clients - the owners fortunate enough to live in these prestigious properties. We interview interior designers, architectural historians, antiques evaluators and other experts that bring the stories of these houses to life.
title: Selling Ireland's Dream Homes

overview: At the age of 29, Tae Myung Ha suddenly enters into a game adapted from a novel, and now 19 years old, he meets his favorite fictional character, Cha Yeo Woon. In the darkest moment of his life, he needs to make Cha Yeo Woon happy, or face dire consequences.
title: Love for Love's Sake

overview: Hyeon, a high school student, writes down his feelings for his friend Dongho in his diary. Then, Dong-ho sees the diary, and the two talk to confirm their feelings for each other. Can the ending for these two be a happy one?
title: Happy Ending

overview: Lin Yumeng stands up for her friend who has been deceived by her playboy boyfriend. The confrontation escalates from a war of words to a full-blown physical fight. As a martial arts descendent, Lin Yumeng, in the midst of a quibble, "accidentally" damages a luxury car, leading to an absurd situation where she is unable to compensate the whimsical owner, Ji Lingsu. He insists that she sign a contract to settle the debt! After marriage, Lin Yumeng's life undergoes a drastic transformation. She is subjected to various arrangements and "bullying" by Ji Dashao. As she delves deeper into the understanding of the Ji family, Lin Yumeng starts to sympathize with her contractual husband. She actively disrupts the stepmother's conspiracy and secures her biological mother's shares. In the process, she inadvertently "loses" her own heart. What was initially just a "contract marriage" turns into a genuine connection between the male and female protagonists. Oh well, since it's a beautiful mistake, might as well go all the way with it!
title: Have a Crush on You

overview: A jewelry designer, Bai Jinse, accidentally discovered her fiance Zheng Huaichen cheated on her younger sister Bai Linlin. Bai Jinse then tracked her jerk husband to collect evidence as she met the CEO, Mo Sinian, who got stood up by his fiancee. The two people hit it off and decided to marry by contract. After marriage, Mo Sinian helped Bai Jinse get rid of her cheating fiance and go back to work. During their relationship, they also developed sincere feelings with each other.
title: Attacking Lady

overview: Shen Xingyu, a female CEO, marries a humble security guard, Zhao Wudi, to save her company. Together, they overcome challenges, unite against dark forces, and develop a genuine bond, transcending their social statuses. Through trials, they discover the essence of marriage and true love.
title: My Name is Zhao Wudi

overview: Join Iain Stirling as he shows you the Islanders as you've never seen them before.
title: Love Island: All Stars - Unseen Bits

overview: Every person born from a donor might have multiple siblings they had no idea existed. This series joins a group of donor conceived people as they open this Pandora's Box. Born From the Same Stranger follows searchers as they unite with a host of brothers and sisters or track down anonymous donors who never imagined they could be found.
title: Born From the Same Stranger

overview: Wauters vs. Waes is a joint Flemish television program VTM and One, shown since January 13, 2014 at both stations is. The first five episodes were broadcasted by one with a repeat on the same night by VTM. During the last five episodes, the roles were reversed. It is the first entertainment program that since the establishment of the commercial station will be realized in 1989 in cooperation with the public channel. Koen Wauters, a VTM celebrity, and Tom Waes, a the faces of one, go ten challenges to decide who is the most impressive now. Als coaches, jury en supporters treden onder andere Cath Luyten en Cathérine Moerkerke op. As coaches, judges and supporters join include Cath Luyten and Catherine Moerkerke on. The program is co-produced by the independent production deMENSEN and internal VTM-production Operation Cuckoo. In March 2015, the program won at the World Media Festival prize in the category 'Other Entertainment'. On April 18, 2015, the program won the Gala of the Flemish Television Stars 2015 Star for Best Entertainment Programme.
title: Wauters vs. Waes

overview: ITV's hugely popular culinary couple John Torode and Lisa Faulkner are set to embark on a journey of a lifetime that will see the pair travel 500 miles along the beautiful coast of Western Australia, in search of the very best local food and wine for John & Lisa's Food Trip Down Under. Proud Australian chef John Torode will travel with his wife, actress and home cook, Lisa Faulkner along a gourmet route of discovery as he returns to the place where his passion for food and cooking began. There they'll seek out chefs, food fanatics and entrepreneurs creating incredible produce in new ways, from black truffles to abalone. They'll meet established winemakers and experience some of Western Australia's most beautiful landscapes.
title: John & Lisa's Food Trip Down Under

overview: In this warm but eye-opening series, six people from across Britain, who are each living with obesity, travel the globe to learn the diverse reasons why people around the world are affected by obesity.
title: Around the World in 80 Weighs

overview: Set during the year 1910 in old Shanghai, it follows an inconsequential paparazzi who becomes a bigshot in the industry and his involvement with ten female celebrities whose glamorous lives are accompanied by a dark side.
title: Shanghai Picked Flowers

overview: Matilha, a good-hearted Lisbon criminal, tries to keep his new job and build an honest life with Mafalda, his girlfriend. But the world of crime is knocking on his door again and the way out is not easy. They face great dangers and will have to make decisive choices.
title: Matilha

overview: Join Milkshake! presenters for singalongs and rhymes!
title: Milkshake! Monkey's Top Nanas Rhymes

overview: Meryem, formerly known as Maria, travels to Istanbul with her husband Kemal and children for his sister's wedding. However, their plans to return to their home in Spain are abruptly disrupted when Kemal goes missing and is later found dead in a burned-out car with a woman Meryem has never met. Believing that Kemal was murdered, Meryem vows to stay in Istanbul until she finds his killer. However, she must navigate a new life in a foreign land, among a family who is wary of her and a community who struggles to accept her. Despite the challenges, Meryem finds unexpected love with Aziz, the designer of her wedding ring, Leylifler. Their paths become illuminated by Leylifer's light, and Meryem begins to reclaim her identity in this new home.
title: Leylifer

overview: The Hula Bowl is a post-season college football all-star game held annually, usually in January. From inception through the 2021 playing, it was held in Hawaii; since the 2022 edition, it has been played in Orlando, Florida. The game was first staged in 1947, between mainland collegiate players and local Hawaiian players; it has been played exclusively with collegiate players since 1960. The bowl was paused following its 2008 edition, then was revived in January 2020. The game was originally held at Honolulu Stadium in Honolulu, then moved to Aloha Stadium in Halawa starting with the January 1976 edition. The game remained at Aloha Stadium through the 2021 edition, except for eight editions played at War Memorial Stadium on the island of Maui. The University of Central Florida (UCF) agreed to host the January 2022 playing of the game, due to Aloha Stadium being closed for repairs and upgrades.
title: Hula Bowl

overview: A nerve-wracking story about an ordinary truck driver and family man in a small town, who makes a fatal mistake while smuggling refugees.
title: Försvunna människor

overview: A wealthy desert family finds themselves in a scandal that they cannot run from.
title: Scottsdale

overview: Come along to Camilla's Moroccan family where she gets to learn about the Moroccan baking culture together to understand more about where she belongs. Camilla has always felt too Swedish in Morocco and too Moroccan in Sweden and never really felt 100% at home anywhere. With this program, she hopes not only to offer new exciting baking pleasure, but also understanding and recognition.
title: Camilla Hamids bakresa: Marocko

overview: Dijana is a proud Balkan mother and retired cleaner. Her daughter Andrea is officially a successful artist, but unofficially still living with her mother. When medical care fails to help Dijana with her chronic pain, Andrea decides to treat her herself. In his own original and unexpected way.
title: Painkiller

overview: Ambitious models compete in a series of fashion challenges before facing judgement from a panel of Latino cultural luminaries.
title: Model Latina

overview: Series following the work of medical teams in University Hospital Coventry's trauma unit as they try to save the lives of people injured in traffic collisions.
title: A&E: Crash Scene Emergency

overview: Since relocation to Chek Lap Kok in 1998, passenger traffic at Hong Kong International Airport has increased threefold in twenty-five years. And Yeung Sheung-wai, who started out as a clerk, has been promoted to IAC Duty Manager. He is tasked with overseeing the operations of the airport. Sheung-wai also has a contingent of amicable partners, including his assistant-cum-admirer Fong Ho-yee, Lui Chi-shan – who handles airport passenger services – Chan Kit – who takes care of aviation security – and Lee Sing-cheung, who is responsible for apron services. They collaborate to assist in dealing with all kinds of incidents that take place at the airport. Sheung-wai keeps in touch with his ex-wife Cheung Yeuk-ling, Metro Harbour Airlines Airport Supervisor. Actually, they still think of each other after their divorce. The duo's relationship is rekindled when airline captain Kwok Kai-kwong and flight attendant Ko Nga-man turn up.
title: The Airport Diary

overview: This twelve part HBO mini-series tells the story of the United States' space program, from its beginnings in 1961 to the final moon mission in 1972. Tom Hanks served as Executive Producer and introduced each segment.
title: From the Earth to the Moon

overview: Frank Bourassa's Fake Millions tells the incredible story of Frank Bourassa, the conductor of one of the most incredible stories of American counterfeiting of all time. His greatest crime? Printing tens of millions of US dollars. His biggest move? To still be at large!
title: Frank Bourassa's Fake Millions

overview: Chun Yu escaped from the 'ghost building' and recovered miraculously after a mental breakdown. Ever since she received a text message from her phone that said "I know what the 19th floor of hell is?"; she has been inexplicably caught in an extremely terrifying game of hell that she can't get out of.
title: 19th Floor

overview: Xiao Lan, the herbs elf in Herb Village, unexpectedly saved the medical officer A Jiu, who could break through the "boundary" of Herb Village. Little did she know that A Jiu, in addition to being the revered "Divine Healer Jiu", had a hidden identity - the commander of the Shangqing Bureau tasked with capturing herb elf, Jiu Ming. Xiao Lan and A Jiu, through a twist of fate, formed a special bond where they share lifes and wounds, leading to a cat-and-mouse game and unveiling the intertwined destinies of their past and present lives.
title: The Divine Healer

overview: After the founding of the People's Republic of China, He Changsheng, driven by the desire to support socialist construction, relocated from Jiangdu, Yangzhou to Huainan, Anhui with his entire family. They put down roots along the banks of the Huai River. Over the next two decades, He Changsheng was blessed with six daughters. Regrettably, he lost his life in a car accident. The eldest sister, He Jiali, along with her grandmother, Mrs. He, and mother, Liu Meixin, stepped forward to shoulder the heavy responsibilities of the family. They worked hard to help the younger sisters get married and build their own lives and careers. As the era evolved, the six He sisters also went through various twists and turns in their love lives, marriages, careers, and daily lives. Nevertheless, they stand united, bravely confronting the trials and tribulations of life. Through the grind of life, the six sisters finally come to comprehend the profound significance of "family" that their father have constantly emphasized during his lifetime.
title: Six Sisters

overview: "Legend of Zang Hai" follows the son of Imperial Astronomer Kuai Duo. Consumed by vengeance, he spends a decade honing his skills. Assuming the name Zang Hai, he ventures into the capital to uncover the truth, avenge his family, and restore justice.
title: Legend of Zang Hai

overview: Huacheng local police station sergeant Chang Sheng is facing a double crisis of career and life: in the hope of becoming deputy director of the wasted, and his wife Zhou Ying years of marriage also came to an end. At this time is encountered in the area of Dongzhai station station police Lao Sun died of sudden illness on duty, so Changsheng chose self-exile, came to this remote station to take over. When I first arrived in Dongzhai, I faced the frequent theft of goods from the station and various difficulties of local villagers, and I was miserable. With the help of village teacher Wang Dongyu, Chang Sheng began to learn how to deal with villagers. Chang Wang and the two never fought "enemies" who did not know each other, and became "partners" with full tacit understanding.
title: Small Police Station

overview: A brave girl Aminka participates in a children's tournament for the title of "Queen of the Yard". She challenges the local leader to fight for peace and friendship in fun and exciting competitions. A bright comedy series for children with a young star-blogger "Aminka Vitaminka" in the title role.
title: Королева двора

overview: Two students become engrossed with their handsome research subject until his true nature puts them in harm's way.
title: Fatal Vows: Lethal Love Triangle

overview: Experts investigate some of the world's most epic monuments across the globe from America, Egypt, Rome and beyond. What engineering techniques were used to build these iconic structures? Coming up in this series, experts reveal the hidden secrets of these constructions using technology to blow them apart and understand what lies within. From lost tombs in the Valley of the Kings, new discoveries made beneath the tomb of Jesus Christ, and joining the hunt for King Arthur's castle, this series is set to blow your mind.
title: Blowing Up History: Seven Wonders

overview: Renata Malone is an Italian-American housewife who hosts a live cooking show from her home in a fourth-floor apartment in Brooklyn. The action is constantly interrupted by a procession of zany friends, relatives, and neighbors who stream in and out out of the apartment.
title: Mama Malone

overview: Mysterious fiction series in which Hawa and Adam, two teenagers who do not know each other, can communicate through a special book.
title: Hawa en Adam

overview: Children's wildlife series shot on location in Wales and featuring the voice talents of actor Derek Griffiths.
title: Seaside Antics

overview: In 2001 a new series entitled Little Antics was produced for 40 episodes and Like Animal Antics the series adopted the fly on the wall style. This time each episode followed the lives of young children, both in and out of school, mainly in a reception class in Malvern.
title: Little Antics

overview: Sitcom about flatmates Josh, Kate and Owen, and their annoying landlord Geoff.
title: Josh

overview: High Road, Low Road is a fun, travel show which pairs top celebrities and sends them off to popular holiday destinations, city break favourites and far flung places for an unforgettable adventure of discovery, culture and fun! However…Both are headed to the same location, but they'll have very different experiences. For one holidaymaker, it's first class travel, luxury hotels and the finest cuisine. Five-star all the way. For their companion, it's economy travel, budget digs and local street food. So as one is driven off in a limo to their luxurious five-star hotel, the other sets off to find the shuttle bus to their hostel. They will meet up several times on the trip to compare notes, and gloat. But at the end it's interesting to hear them talk and decide who has had the better time…
title: High Road, Low Road

overview: Melba is an American sitcom about the home and work life of Melba Patterson (Moore), a divorced mother who was the director of New York's Manhattan Visitors Center. Melba was raising her 9-year-old daughter Tracy (Jamilla Perry) with the help of her mother Rose (Barbara Meek) and her white "sister", Susan Slater (Gracie Harrison). Melba and Susan had been close since childhood, since Rose was Susan's family's housekeeper when they were growing up. Jack (Lou Jacobi) and young Gil (Evan Mirand) worked for Melba at the visitors' center.
title: Melba

overview: Ivan, who just turned 50, has two daughters: the eldest, the hero Marya, and the youngest, the aspiring sorceress Sophia. Everything in Belogorye goes on as usual, but the visit of the sorcerer Severin, who imagined a terrible disaster, brings confusion into the measured life of the wizards. To save both Belogorye and the life of her own father, Sophia will have to go to the Moscow of the past, where the young and unsuspecting Ivan still lives, and Marya will have to fight evil in the city itself.
title: Последний богатырь. Наследие

overview: Sometimes we make a request to the Universe, without even assuming that all people's requests are answered by only two ministries: in the Ministry of All Good there are good-natured people and goofballs, but in the Ministry of All Bad, as you can see, there are super-effective managers.
title: Министерство Всего Хорошего

overview: The problem requires an urgent solution, and then Anton's older brother, the bully Mikha, finds a daring way out of the situation: he, together with his friends, finds a recipe for an inaccessible medicine on the darknet and begins to "cook" it in an underground laboratory.
title: Фарма

overview: Twin sisters Anya and Nadya Vdovin grew up in an orphanage, and determined Anya was used to always protecting her sister from any dangers. However, the girls' paths diverged: Anna became a professional MMA fighter, and Nadya, tired of her sister's tutelage, fled to Japan in search of her own path and freedom. After years of separation, Anya receives an alarming message from her sister, in which she asks for help. The girl tries to get at least some information, but all efforts are in vain. Then Anna decides to go to Japan, where she will have to enter into an unequal duel with the Yakuza, who sold her sister into sexual slavery.
title: Амура

overview: Uncle Lesha is an ordinary janitor who works in an orphanage in a small town. At night, he robs the houses of wealthy residents, and he spends the loot for the needs of the same orphanage. His scheme fails when three of the most hooligan students accidentally catch Uncle Lesha "at work." The hero has no choice but to take the youth as his accomplices... From this moment on, Uncle Lesha's life turns into an attraction, and he has to solve a mountain of problems from his new "companions," confuse the investigation of his own crimes, regain the trust of the woman he loves, and pay for serious mistakes past, and most importantly, to implement your "Robin Hood plan" to the end. The life of his accomplices also changes - because thanks to this adventure they acquire a "fatherly figure".
title: Дядя Лёша

overview: Hell on Wheels is an American Western television series about the construction of the First Transcontinental Railroad across the United States. The series follows the Union Pacific Railroad and its surveyors, laborers, prostitutes, mercenaries, and others who lived, worked and died in the mobile encampment called "Hell on Wheels" that followed the railhead west across the Great Plains. In particular, the story focuses on Cullen Bohannon, a former Confederate soldier who, while working as foreman and chief engineer on the railroad, initially attempts to track down the Union soldiers who murdered his wife and young son during the American Civil War.
title: Hell on Wheels

overview: Zoo is a global thriller about a wave of violent animal attacks against humans sweeping the planet. Jackson Oz is a young, renegade American zoologist who spends his days running safaris in the wilds of Africa when he begins noticing the strange behavior of the animals. As the assaults become more cunning, coordinated and ferocious, he is thrust into the race to unlock the mystery of the pandemic before there's no place left for people to hide. Based on James Patterson's #1 bestselling novel.
title: Zoo

overview: Alaska y Mario is a Spanish reality show based on the daily life of Alaska and her husband Mario Vaquerizo.
title: Alaska y Mario

overview: Welcome to Superior Air! Buckle up, put your seat in the upright position, and get ready for the jokes to fly at 30,000 feet.
title: Ça décolle

overview: Hidden cameras reveal the secretive world of foxes in their underground homes.
title: Milkshake! Fantastic Foxes: Their Secret World

overview: Using hidden cameras we find out all about the secretive European Badgers.
title: Milkshake! Badgers: Their Secret World

overview: In 2003 a new 40-episode series aired again narrated by Griffiths. This series was directed Tracy Nampala but now followed the lives of insects. Victoria Arlidge provided the music for this run. An episode from this series was issued on the 'Milkshake! Treats' DVD in 2005.
title: Insect Antics

overview: A further 40 episodes aired in 2004 and was now called Aussie Antics. Again showing different animals in their natural environment. This time focusing on animals that live in Australia. Tracy Nampala also directed this series.
title: Aussie Antics

overview: The story of Ireland's country house gardens is also the story of the men and women who commissioned, designed, and maintained them. Author and historian Robert O'Byrne examines the history of Ireland's spectacular country house gardens over the last 400 years during which time the garden design reflected the political and social changes taking place within the country.
title: Ireland's Historic Gardens

overview: Blind Justice chronicles the journey of Detective Jim Dunbar, an officer blinded in a shootout because of his partner's negligence. Refusing retirement after his injury, Dunbar instead fights to remain on the job, challenging preconceived stereotypes and conventional wisdom. Ultimately successful in his attempt to win reinstatement of his badge, Dunbar is assigned to a new precinct, where everyone says they respect his heroism, but where few are willing to accept him as an equal.
title: Blind Justice

overview: The kitchen is the heart of Donal Skehan's home. In this series, Donal shares recipes to suit every kind of busy household, time-saving hacks and practical cooking tips.
title: Donal Skehan: Home Cook

overview: Kerry Daynes brings us stories of brutal murders from the Victorian era. Alongside experts in their field, she discovers that the motives which drove the killers are incredibly familiar and still have the power to intrigue and shock today.
title: The Victorian Murder Files

overview: How the beloved English garden evolved through the ages to delight the senses from the Roman, Medieval and Renaissance periods. This two-part series, featuring renowned experts in the field, is and a revelation for garden enthusiasts everywhere.
title: A Short History of the English Garden

overview: 1911 A graduate of the Institute of Noble Maidens, Sasha Meshcherskaya returns to a small provincial town. The well-being of her family is based on her relationship with her loving uncle, the owner of the arms factory Nikolai Shumilov. Sashenka's parents, Prince Ivan Sergeevich Meshchersky and Maria Ilyinichna, dream of their daughter getting married as soon as possible, and she herself dreams of a career as an architect. Wanting to please her parents, Sasha makes new acquaintances and plunges into a whirlpool of intrigue, where political interests are at stake. Cold-blooded murders, blackmail, intricacies of conspiracies and daring provocateurs eluding detection - all this captivates the enthusiastic schoolgirl. Without noticing it, Sasha becomes an ideal subject for terrorist hypnosis.
title: Куколка

overview: An ambitious professor of psychiatry, Viktor Meshchersky, conducts a dangerous psychological experiment, in which he locks victims and their abusers in the basement under false pretenses, hiding his true goals. The subsequent investigation will reveal the real motives of the professor, and will connect together the intricate stories of all participants in the cruel experiment.
title: Калимба

overview: Petersburg, 1903. A world of luxury and leisure for men, a world of fear and submission for women. Ksenia and Stesha work in an underground brothel under the control of a pretty and ruthless lady. Girls sell men their bodies, feelings, flirting and the illusion of love. It seems they have nothing but beauty. In fact, they have access to a secret power - purity of the soul and the desire for freedom. And with this power they can change everything.
title: Чистые

overview: The Shatalov family plays an important role in the life of their area. The head of the family, Alena, runs a management company that serves the entire neighborhood. Her husband Mikhail is a doctor at a district clinic, and their twenty-year-old son Artem serves as a district police officer. Every day this magnificent family solves the everyday problems of the residents of their area, constantly finding themselves in funny and curious situations. But one day the Shatalovs' personal problems grow to the scale of a domestic disaster. Will they be able to maintain peace in the family and maintain order in the area?
title: Ангелы района

overview: Sasha, who lost her parents early, always wanted to become a landscape designer. But her dream did not come true — the nominal scholarship that the girl studied for was withdrawn without explanation, and Sasha lost the chance to continue her studies. The company covering the scholarship is run by a young and talented architect Sergey Gradsky, who recently broke up with a girl and found out that the ex was going to get married. Sasha decides to deal with the businessman who ruined her dream. Their meeting turns into a series of curious situations, as a result of which Sasha and Sergey agree to pose as a couple in love for two months so that Sergei gets back together with his ex, and Sasha can return to university.
title: Постучись в мою дверь в Москве

overview: An engineer (John D. Michaels) at a major tech company sneaks a skeptical journalist (Maria-Elena Laas) inside to interview what he believes is the first sentient AI (Chase Simone).
title: Sigma_001

overview: Having lost herself, Olga Shilkovskaya also loses her only son. When her husband takes her child away from her, she decides to return to law practice and makes a career in divorce and family litigation. But saving yourself turns out to be more difficult than becoming a media and successful lawyer. People come to Olga for help when they find themselves in a hopeless situation and there is no way to resolve the conflict peacefully. She finds creative ways out of the situation so as not to bring the case to court. No one knows how hard it really is for her...
title: Неверные

overview: 1983, the city of Brezhnev (modern Naberezhnye Chelny). 15-year-old Arthur's parents send him to a pioneer camp, where he meets two counselors - Vitalik Solovyov and Marina. This meeting becomes fateful for everyone. Solovyov is a former Afghan, a strong, handsome, cheerful and smart guy. In a skirmish with local hooligans, he saves Arthur and his friends. The next meeting of the guys will take place in the city: Marina will come to work at the school where Arthur studies, and Vitalik will become a driver for one of the factory bosses, and then for Vadim Vazykh, Arthur's father.
title: Город Брежнев

overview: February 1934. Navigating the Northern Sea Route in one navigation was an ambitious goal and was of great importance for the USSR. Many considered this venture to be a futile and risky undertaking. Young and daring polar explorers, led by Otto Schmidt, sincerely believed that on the Chelyuskin steamship they would be able to complete their task. But great ideas turned into a great tragedy - the ship was trapped in ice and sank. Now, in the harsh Arctic conditions, the "Chelyuskinites" have to fight for their lives every minute.
title: Челюскин. Первые

overview: Yug Kipen is a reserved, modest boy raised by his grandmother. Yug's mother died when he was three years old, and he never saw his father. Everything changes when, on his 14th birthday, Yug discovers money from his father in his grandmother's closet. From this moment begins the story of the South's great journey in search of his father. Potential fathers are scattered throughout Russia. The South will have to cross the entire country to meet everyone. He will visit the most beautiful corners of our country, and of course, he will see the main attraction of Russia - the people! To make such a journey for a 14-year-old teenager, in principle, is not easy, and for the South it is even more difficult, because he has a bunch of phobias that he will have to overcome every time.
title: Юг

overview: Artyom Steklov, an operative of the Main Directorate for Drug Control of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia, together with a colleague from Sochi, is conducting an operation to detain Kostik, the son of a major Sochi drug dealer, Viktor Khromov. As a result of the operation, Kostik is arrested, and Artem testifies against him. Fearing the revenge of the criminals, Artyom's family is sent to a safe place. However, Kostik and his fighters manage to discover the whereabouts of Artem Steklov and his family. Bandits attack the operative's house, kill his wife and seriously wound his daughter. Wanting revenge, Artyom goes south to find his wife's killers.
title: Сармат

overview: The first reality series based on KION. A unique clinic from the popular series opens its doors in real life. A team of experts - doctors, psychologists, sexologists - has only 3 days to save the families of the participants and strengthen their marriage. 24 couples from all over the country will try the most unexpected approaches and practices in order to better know themselves and their spouse through laughter and tears, restore the joy of love, and find their own formula of happiness. All that is required from the participants is maximum frankness, but are they ready to truly open up? Real people's stories are a real chance to change family relationships for the better.
title: Клиника счастья. Реалити

overview: Charming goofball Artyom taxis in his parents' car, plays basketball with friends and generally does not bother about life. Artyom also has a neighbor, Lenya, an eighteen-year-old boy with an autism spectrum disorder who lives under the overprotection of his mother. One day, visiting Artyom, Lenya sees on the computer screen a video with a beautiful girl, with whom he immediately and unconditionally falls in love. He demands to urgently go to St. Petersburg together and find this girl.
title: Она такая классная

overview: Welcome to Talkoma FD a weekly behind the scenes show for season 4 of Tacoma FD with your hosts Kevin Heffernan & Steve Lemme.
title: Talkoma FD

overview: Report to Murphy is about the everyday problems and frustrations of a parole officer, as he deals with the released prisoners that come and go.
title: Report to Murphy

overview: Goldie's teenage life is turned upside down when her family flies from America to the UK to move in with their Grandpa Maury and his three ‘70 something' roommates.
title: Goldie's Oldies

overview: One of the longest running Japanese television series, Abarendo Shogun is much like most other chambara features. The show's hero is the cheerful and generous shogun Yoshimune Tokugawa, who routinely disguises himself as Shinosuke Tokuda, the third son of a poor hatamoto (a bannerman retainer of a shogun).In this disguise, he mingles unnoticed with the public in the city of Edo.
title: Abarenbô Shôgun

overview: Join pioneering athletes as they take on awe-inspiring challenges in some of the world's most spectacular locations.
title: Adventure

overview: Get up close and personal with some of the most charismatic creatures on the planet — and uncover what makes them unique with the experts who know them best. The first episode brings viewers into the world's largest rhino sanctuary where a former police captain has dedicated her life to rescuing, raising and rewilding these gentle giants.
title: Wild Life

overview: Will Azem Yücedağ, who was released from prison after years, find what he lost? Will Azem, who is chasing hope with his painful past, a great secret he carries inside him and the burden of life on his back, be able to collect the scattered pearls from his necklace again?
title: İnci Taneleri

overview: Born as the third son of the Kishu clan, Yoshimune rose to become the eighth Tokugawa shogun after his father and older brother died one after another. It depicts the life of a man who carried out the Kyoho reforms and was called the father of the revival of the Edo shogunate.
title: Hachidai Shôgun Yôshimune

overview: A group of high school students are stranded in a deserted forest after a bus accident while they were on a camping trip. Five young people who survived the accident struggle to survive while confronting the dark aspects within themselves.
title: Kurtuluş Lisesi

overview: Here comes the 7-day vacation full of laughter! Come enjoy Italy to the fullest! Follow the lead of Guide Na with SEVENTEEN! Na PD, a 20-year veteran of travel entertainment shows, got a new job as a tour guide and became Guide Na! He's the tour guide for SEVENTEEN who's going on a vacation into the summer of Italy!
title: NANA TOUR with SEVENTEEN

overview: The couple that swims together, stays together. Comics Julie Wilson Nimmo and Greg Hemphill take the plunge at Scotland's breathtaking and beautiful wild swimming spots.
title: Jules and Greg's Wild Swim

overview: In 1996, on the eve of Russia's adoption of a moratorium on the death penalty, a new warden, Konstantin, entered the special purpose prison. Konstantin and his colleagues ― the prison doctor, the prosecutor, and other guards ― are deeply traumatized and unhappy people, and around the dangerous and terrible period of the mid-90s. After meeting with the father of one of the victims, Konstantin realizes that it is close people who have the right to carry out punishment. Kostya, with the support of his colleagues, comes up with a new business ― outsourcing the execution of the death penalty. But it soon turns out that money and justice are incompatible. As soon as there is an opportunity to earn money, there are people who are ready to sacrifice any principles...
title: Аутсорс

overview: 70 years after a body is found floating in a Sydney river, middle aged doctor Jack learns his father, a Holocaust survivor, is allegedly responsible for the unsolved murder of a Nazi and sets out on a quest to find the truth.
title: Revenge: Our Dad The Nazi Killer
